name: Virtual Families 1 Patcher
description: Patch settings for the Virtual Families 1 Patcher. Each setting is a switch in "Virtual Families 1 Patcher Files\settings.ini", section [Patches], read by vf1fun.dll when the game starts. To add a setting, add a row here: id (the settings.ini key), label, description, default, category (main or optional), and optionally requires (ids of settings it cannot work without; the patcher states them in bold) and files (payload files installed into the Virtual Families 1 Patcher Files folder only while the setting is on).

settings.label: Fix Vanilla Game Bugs
settings.description: Keeps a brand-new family if the game is closed without quitting (the original game only saved before the adoption). In the Power Failure event, choosing to keep the food now says the food was not ok when people really get sick (the original game always said it was fine).

settings.label: Older Villager Mortality Curve
settings.description: Replaces only the yearly old-age death roll with the Virtual Families 2 patcher's calibrated curve, which accelerates past effective age 110. Active food groups still subtract 0-4 effective years. No hard maximum age (the original game's roll made death certain by about 75).

settings.label: Private Adult Romantic Time
settings.description: A married opposite-sex couple at six children can still have private romantic time when one is dropped on the other, with the stock cooldown (the original game refuses with "They have enough kids already!"). Same-sex couples already could. No baby is possible while the family is full.

settings.label: Add visible mobile version purchases
settings.description: Special Upgrades in the Upgrades menu: Brokerage Account, Food Club, Health Plan and Lucky Rock, as in the Virtual Families 2 patcher, plus a Maid and a Gardener who keep the house and yard clean.

settings.label: Cheat Upgrades
settings.description: Adds the Upgrades button's cheat pages: money, food, interest rate, villager cheats, store price multipliers, achievements and collections, house and yard mess, time controls (pause, speed, time warp), and the Family page (same-sex marriage, candidate reroll, divorce, pregnancy one-shots, new babies and adopted children, Adopt New Person after a game over, Evict Family).

settings.label: Flea Market
settings.description: Every tray item the store sells, to buy or get for free.

settings.label: Roll the Dice
settings.description: $500: an island event happens right away.
